title: Stan Marcus tells Nick Cook the bell slowed time

tellings.quote: And Nick Cook's source, Stan Marcus, told him that the Germans had been able to slow time within the area of the bell's torsion field.

plain: In a documentary about an American inventor named Townsend Brown, the podcast host Jesse Michels retells a claim about "the Bell", a device said to have been built in secret in Nazi Germany in the 1940s. Michels says that a source named Stan Marcus told the writer Nick Cook that the Germans had managed to slow down time inside a twisting energy field around the Bell. If true, it would mean wartime Germany had touched physics far beyond anything known.
